title: solo dev here - built an ai rpg - looking for feedback
author: Diligent-Garage1773
selftext:
hey r/aigamedev

im a solo dev and ive been building starworld ai - its an ai-powered rpg but like... an actual game, not just a text box.

the ai generates you a personal 100-chapter sci-fi story with recurring characters and plot threads that pay off later. you pick your motivation at the start and it shapes everything. but theres also real combat (atb style like old jrpgs), real loot to farm, gear enhancement from +0 to +10, three talent trees to build into, and ranked pvp with seasonal rewards

basically i wanted to see what happens when you combine ai storytelling with actual game design instead of just... vibes

its f2p, no ads, no paywalls. you earn cores daily to play chapters, pay if you want to go faster but you dont need to

just rebuilt the whole thing from scratch - new combat engine, new progression, new economy. if you tried it before and bounced this is basically a different game now

looking for people to try it and tell me whats broken or what sucks. honest feedback helps

still trying to figure out endgame beyond PvP so would be really excited if people had ideas there

thanks!

(and before people ask: yes it will be coming to android, sorry I have an iPhone!!)

https://starworldai.com
